openapi.groups.workflow.name: Workflow
openapi.groups.workflow.description: Workflow definitions and instances of the platform and tenants, organization-based assignees, and the approval business integration.
openapi.tags.workflow_definitions.name: Workflow definitions
openapi.tags.workflow_definitions.descri: Create, edit, publish, version, disable, archive and delete workflow definitions; list the approval businesses and the activity types available to the designer.
openapi.tags.workflow_instances.name: Workflow instances
openapi.tags.workflow_instances.descript: List and inspect workflow instances, start them, and cancel, terminate, retry, suspend, resume or signal them.
openapi.tags.workflow_assignees.name: Workflow assignees
openapi.tags.workflow_assignees.descript: Users, roles, positions and departments to choose from when configuring assignees, transferring or adding approvers.
permissions.workflow.workflow_definition: View the workflow definitions of the caller's side and their documents.
Create drafts and new versions of workflow definitions.
Edit drafts, publish, disable and archive workflow definitions.
View the workflow instances of the caller's side, their history and waits, and any approval detail.
Start, cancel, terminate and retry instances and publish signals.
Suspend and resume running workflow instances.
List roles, positions and departments when choosing assignees.
workflow_definitions.list.title: List workflow definitions
workflow_definitions.list.description: Page through the workflow definitions of the caller's side, filtered by keyword (name, display name, description), name, category and status, ordered by name and then by version descending.
workflow_definitions.get.title: Get a workflow definition
workflow_definitions.get.description: Read a workflow definition with its whole document, as the designer opens it.
workflow_definitions.create.title: Create a workflow definition
workflow_definitions.create.description: Create a draft from a WorkflowJson document; the version is the highest version of the same name plus one.
workflow_definitions.update.title: Update a workflow definition
workflow_definitions.update.description: Replace the document of a draft; the name and version stay as stored.
workflow_definitions.publish.title: Publish a workflow definition
workflow_definitions.publish.description: Publish a draft after the approval business check and the structural validation; all problems are listed in the error details.
workflow_definitions.new_version.title: Create a new version
workflow_definitions.new_version.descrip: Copy the latest version of a name into a new draft.
workflow_definitions.disable.title: Disable workflow definitions
workflow_definitions.disable.description: Disable published definitions; running instances finish as usual.
workflow_definitions.archive.title: Archive workflow definitions
workflow_definitions.delete.title: Delete workflow definitions
workflow_definitions.business_types.desc: List the approval businesses registered by the packages: business code (the definition name), display name, form component, start variables and allowed outcomes.
workflow_definitions.activity_types.desc: List the activity types the designer may place, with their inputs.
workflow_instances.list.title: List workflow instances
workflow_instances.list.description: Page through the workflow instances of the caller's side, filtered by title keyword, status, definition name, correlation ID, starter and creation time, newest first.
workflow_instances.get.title: Get a workflow instance
workflow_instances.get.description: Read a workflow instance with its variables, node history, pending waits and the definition it runs.
workflow_instances.start.title: Start a workflow
workflow_instances.start.description: Start an instance of the latest published version (or a given version) of a definition, with the caller as the starter.
workflow_instances.cancel.title: Cancel workflow instances
workflow_instances.cancel.description: Cancel running, suspended or faulted instances, compensating when enabled.
workflow_instances.terminate.title: Terminate workflow instances
workflow_instances.terminate.description: Terminate running, suspended or faulted instances without compensation.
workflow_instances.retry.title: Retry workflow instances
workflow_instances.retry.description: Rerun faulted instances from their faulted node.
workflow_instances.suspend.title: Suspend workflow instances
workflow_instances.resume.title: Resume workflow instances
workflow_instances.signal.title: Publish a signal
workflow_instances.signal.description: Resume the instances of the caller's side waiting for a signal, optionally only those with a correlation ID, and return how many waits it resumed.
workflow_assignees.users.title: Choose users
workflow_assignees.users.description: Search the active accounts visible on the caller's side by keyword, or look them up by ID; support members are not included.
workflow_assignees.roles.title: Choose roles
workflow_assignees.roles.description: List the enabled roles of the caller's side; assignee rules refer to them by code.
workflow_assignees.positions.title: Choose positions
workflow_assignees.positions.description: List the enabled positions of the tenant; empty on the platform side.
workflow_assignees.departments.title: Choose departments
workflow_assignees.departments.descripti: List the departments of the tenant as a flat list to build a tree from; empty on the platform side.
workflow.business.outcome_invalid: End node '{node}' must declare one of the outcomes allowed by the approval business ({allowed}), but declares '{outcome}'.
workflow.business.terminate_forbidden: A definition of an approval business may not contain the terminate node '{node}'.
workflow.query.filter_unsupported: The filter on '{field}' is not supported.
workflow.query.sort_unsupported: Sorting by '{field}' is not supported; the order is fixed.
workflow.assignees.codes_required: The assignee rule '{type}' needs at least one code.
workflow.assignees.level_invalid: The assignee rule '{type}' takes at most one level from 1 to {max}, but got '{value}'.
